youtube.title: Myth: AI video needs an NVIDIA card. This Short rendered on 4 CPU cores with no GPU
youtube.description:
Myth: AI video needs an NVIDIA card.
Fact: funkbox needs OpenGL 3.3; an Intel integrated GPU works. This Short rendered in under 40 seconds on a 4-core CPU with no GPU.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
